title: AU Online Shelf-Price Index
weighting: equal retailer weights; equal product weights within a cell
measures: posted online shelf prices at the named retailers, not prices paid
headlineDefinition: like-for-like: each retailer's matched products in the classes where Coles has at least 20 used products that week; the 3 retailers weighted equally
